title: The canonical integral-system bridge preserves a binary open compositor
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, an Operations package $o$ and its section-normalized Compositors $c$ [def-sf-integral-system-operations], and a section-normalized CanonicalBridge $b$ [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge]. Write $J_j=o.\mathrm{shriek}(j)$, $J^0_j$ for intrinsic semilinear open extension with scalarRings and scalarTransitions, $e_{j,k}:J_jJ_k\cong J_{jk}$ for c.openComp, $e^0_{j,k}$ for the intrinsic jComp [def-sf-semilinear-proper-open-comparisons], and $b_j:J_j\cong J^0_j$ for b.shriek. For arbitrary composable open immersions $j:U\to V$, $k:V\to X$ of schemes and every derived coefficient system $M$ on $U$, in diagrammatic composition order, $$e_{j,k}(M)\gg b_{jk}(M)=b_k(J_jM)\gg J^0_k(b_j(M))\gg e^0_{j,k}(M).$$ There is no proper map, proper/open gamma, pasting equation, constructibility restriction or finite-evaluation hypothesis in this assertion.

proof.text: Use pull_bridge_composition from the proved bridge-push-composition module: the canonical inverse-image bridge preserves the binary pullback compositor.

Conjugate the pullback comparison through the three open adjunctions. The proved conjugate_composition_injective, bridge_conjugate and conjugate_leftAdjointComp calculations identify adjoint uniqueness and leftAdjointCompIso. Naturality interchanges the two whiskered bridge factors; evaluation at M gives the required equation.

theorem integralSystemOpenCompositorBridge
    (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o) (b : CanonicalBridge l E o)
    {U V X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ V) (k : V ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion k] (M : System l E U) :
    (c.openComp l E j k).hom.app M ≫ (b.shriek l E (j ≫ k)).hom.app M =
      (b.shriek l E k).hom.app ((Operations.shriek l E o j).obj M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.J (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E) k).map
          ((b.shriek l E j).hom.app M) ≫
        (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.jComp (scalarRings l E) (scalarTransitions l E)
          j k).hom.app M
